description.zh: 给新闻站、杂志、博客和长文阅读 App 的设计系统：暖白纸、近黑墨、一点朱砂，宋体标题配黑体界面，行高 1.9 的正文，细线分栏；带首字下沉、摘句、脚注、目录、阅读进度、评论、订阅和米黄、夜读主题。
description.en: A literary system for news, magazines, blogs and reading apps: ink on warm paper, one vermilion accent, Song serif headings, airy CJK body text, thin rules, plus sepia and night-reading themes.
